summary: Phase 3-5 tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed on /jobs/sync (initial + idempotent + query + source flag), applications (status patch, follow_up_date set + null-clear persistence, notes add/delete), AI (/ai/match with score+summary+strengths+gaps, /ai/match 404 for bad job, /ai/cover-letter returns 1500+ char letter, /ai/match returns 400 for a user with no resume). Frontend: full mobile flow verified on the public Expo web preview — login (Continue), Tracker kanban board with all 5 columns (Saved/Applied/Interviewing/Offer/Rejected), tapping tracker-card opens bottom sheet, stage-chip change moves card to new column (verified Interviewing count → 1), reminder set + clear, notes add + delete, Search tab shows 25 jobs with LIVE pills, searching 'developer' triggers live sync + filters to 4 jobs (3 LIVE), job detail shows ai-tools with working ai-match-button (result rendered) and ai-letter-button (1590-char letter + copy button). Drag-and-drop not attempted (gesture-based, best-effort per request; stage-chip fallback verified). One dev-overlay uncaught error surfaced from @gorhom/bottom-sheet BottomSheetTextInput on web, but the note operation itself succeeds — non-blocking. React-Native-web deprecation warnings (pointerEvents, shadow*, React 19 element.ref) persist from prior iterations.

issues: Company logo URLs (logo.clearbit.com/<domain>) still fail inside the preview sandbox (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED). UI degrades gracefully to empty avatar tile. Non-blocking but hurts polish. Consider colored-initials fallback or bundled placeholder.

react_native_issues.issue: Adding a note via sheet-note-input triggers an uncaught 'RNTextInput.default.State.currentlyFocusedInput is not a function' error (visible as a dev red-box on web). The note itself is added and persisted successfully — this is a react-native-web ↔ @gorhom/bottom-sheet compatibility issue on web builds only, not native. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ApplicationSheet.tsx (BottomSheetTextInput usage around line 204) and node_modules/@gorhom/bottom-sheet/lib/module/components/bottomSheetTextInput/BottomSheetTextInput.js:37.
'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' warnings still surface when opening the ApplicationSheet/FilterSheet. Non-blocking (carry-over from Phase 2 report).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' warnings persist (upstream RN-web / dependency). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) On web, wrap the ApplicationSheet note input with a plain <TextInput> instead of <BottomSheetTextInput>, OR guard the offending handler in @gorhom/bottom-sheet's BottomSheetTextInput to avoid the 'RNTextInput.default.State.currentlyFocusedInput is not a function' error being visible in dev on web. The functionality already works — this is purely to remove the red-box in dev builds on web.
(Optional polish, carry-over) Add a colored-initials avatar fallback when company_logo fails to load — the sandbox cannot resolve logo.clearbit.com and this spams console errors.

routes_jobs.py /sync dedupes by (source='remotive', external_id) — verified idempotent via test (second sync returns synced=0).
All routes still project out MongoDB _id everywhere — no leakage in any tested endpoint.
AiTools.tsx correctly gates Match/Letter buttons on presence of a resume and surfaces ai-no-resume state — matches 400 backend behavior.
